caption:
The video shows a wide outdoor courtyard area with a large green lawn, surrounded by buildings with brick and glass facades. Several red umbrellas are positioned over tables and chairs, suggesting an outdoor seating area. A few palm trees and other small trees are scattered throughout the space. In the foreground, there are steps with railings leading up to the main building entrance.

Throughout the video, people are seen moving around the courtyard. Some individuals walk across the lawn or along the pathways near the buildings. A few people are seen entering or exiting the building through the doors. Others are walking up or down the steps, either alone or in small groups. The movement is casual and unhurried, with people generally heading toward or away from the building entrances or the outdoor seating areas. The overall scene is calm and appears to be a typical day at a campus or public building with people going about their activities.
